label: Development
p0: Memorizing vocabulary and individual phrases.
p1: Abstracting and understanding general grammar rules.
emergence_rationale: Memorizing enough phrases reveals underlying structural patterns.
potential_rationale: The grammatical rules are implicitly present in the phrases being memorized.
determinacy_rationale: Formulating grammar rules makes the previously blind memorization intelligible as applying a structure.

label: Development
p0: Writing raw HTML and CSS for each individual page.
p1: Creating a reusable UI component library.
emergence_rationale: Duplicating code across pages naturally pushes towards extracting common components.
potential_rationale: The common layout and styling patterns exist implicitly within the raw pages.
determinacy_rationale: The component library defines the exact structure that the raw pages were attempting to replicate.

label: Development
p0: Hand-calculating the trajectory of individual thrown objects.
p1: Formulating the general kinematic equations of motion.
emergence_rationale: Repeated calculations reveal constant mathematical relations.
potential_rationale: The kinematic equations are the implicit mathematical ground of the individual trajectories.
determinacy_rationale: The general equations explain why the hand-calculations yielded those specific numbers.

label: Development
p0: Resolving individual disputes on a case-by-case basis.
p1: Writing a formal legal code or constitution.
emergence_rationale: Case-by-case resolutions establish precedents that demand formalization.
potential_rationale: The formal laws are derived directly from the principles implicit in the prior dispute resolutions.
determinacy_rationale: The legal code provides a definitive framework that clarifies the logic of past decisions.

label: Workflow
p0: Chopping vegetables into pieces.
p1: Boiling the chopped vegetables in water.
emergence_rationale: The recipe dictates that chopping is followed by boiling.
potential_rationale: Boiling is an external action applied to the vegetables, not a potential hidden in the chopping process.
determinacy_rationale: Boiling does not make the nature of chopping more determinate; it just physically processes the result.

label: Workflow
p0: Compiling the source code into a binary.
p1: Running the integration test suite on the binary.
emergence_rationale: The CI pipeline requires compilation to finish before testing begins.
potential_rationale: Testing is an external verification process, not a hidden potential within the compiler.
determinacy_rationale: Testing verifies the binary but does not make the compilation process itself more conceptually determinate.

label: Workflow
p0: Filling out the personal details form.
p1: Clicking the submit button to send the form.
emergence_rationale: The form must be completed before it can be submitted.
potential_rationale: Submission is an external network action, not an implicit structure of the form filling.
determinacy_rationale: Submission sends the data but doesn't change the conceptual determination of the data.

label: Workflow
p0: Opening a file handle on the disk.

potential_rationale: Reading lines is a subsequent API call, not a potential embedded in the act of opening a handle.
determinacy_rationale: Reading lines consumes the file but doesn't clarify what opening the file meant.

determinacy_rationale: Renaming the variable does not change the logic or structure of the data.
